notes.title: Update Released 09/03/2015
notes.content:
- Mac users should be able to download and launch now, game runs fullscreen by default.
- Fixed controller issues with tutorials.
- Fixed controller layouts, almost all gamepads should have A and B working as should. [i](Logitech Chillstream works with B = Next and X = Previous, this will be fixed in next update)[/i].

More updates coming this week! Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Dustoff Heli Rescue finally on Steam!
notes.content:
Greetings, Pilots!

We are happy to announce that the game is now released!

- Rescue POWs
- Haul lost or stolen cargo back to the base
- Dodge machine gun fire and rockets
- Explore cave systems built by the enemy
- If you like challenges, try out the Pro controls and the Manual Fire mode!
- Localization up to 10 languages like: English, French, Italian, Spanish, German, Brazilian-Portuguese, Russian, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Japanese!
- Full controller support to enjoy Dustoff in Big Picture Mode!

Good luck, and remember: flying is not dangerous; crashing is dangerous.
